row.notes: like Game_TrackSpace_FindVolume but clamps pos into the grid box (vmaxss against grid+0x68 / +0x70) first and returns the cell's volume nearest to pos by distance to volume+0x10 (volumes grid+0x88, 0x140 each); when the cell has no volume list it falls back to a nearest-centre scan over ALL volumes grid+0x88..+0x90, so it never returns 0 while volumes exist. 21 call sites, 13 listed.
